name: Bombshell Barista: Speed Dating
source:
Bombshell Barista: Speed Dating follows you, a frequent Bombshells Cafe customer, as you interact with the cafe’s baristas and customers alike. During your time at the cafe, you’ll witness lots of lovingly brewed-up transformations and expansions of the locals during their time at the cafe.

Don’t get cocky, though! Rejection is one wrong move away.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《Bombshell Barista: Speed Dating》里，你是魅力咖啡馆的常客，既会和咖啡师打交道，也会结识同来喝咖啡的客人。在店里待上一阵，你将亲眼见证许多当地人在这里发生精心“冲调”的变身，身体也随之膨胀。

不过，别得意得太早！走错一步，人家就可能拒绝你。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496850/]Steam[/url]］
